question: Which type of network topology is commonly used in Wide Area Networks (WANs)?
solution:
The correct answer is __Mesh**(Mesh Topology)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mesh topology__ is extensively used in Wide Area Networks (WANs).
 
• In a mesh topology, each node connects directly to every other node in the network.
 
• This topology is highly reliable as there is no single point of failure. 
 
• Mesh topology ensures redundancy and efficient communication between nodes.
 
• It can handle high traffic loads effectively due to multiple pathways for data transmission.
 
• While it offers excellent performance, it is more complex and costly to set up compared to other topologies.
 
• Mesh topology is ideal for WANs where high reliability and fault tolerance are critical.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Other Network Topologies:**
 
 
• Bus topology: All devices share a single communication line.
 
• Ring topology: Devices are connected in a circular manner.
 
• Star topology: Each device connects to a central hub.
 
• Hybrid topology: Combines features of multiple topologies.
